attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: Clock in when you arrive and clock out when you leave. Times are taken from the server clock.
attendance.status_in_sub: Clock out when you leave the clinic.
attendance.status_out_sub: Clock in when you start your shift.
attendance.qr_only_hint: Your clinic records attendance by scanning the QR code on the screen at the door.
attendance.empty_team_text: Change the filters, or add staff under Team.
attendance.no_plan_note: Working hours are not set, so late and absent are not shown — only what was recorded.
attendance.method_qr_title: Recorded by scanning the QR code at the door
attendance.off_network_title: Scanned from a network other than the door screen’s
attendance.correct_sub: Times are in the clinic’s time zone. Every correction is kept in the audit log.
attendance.correct_help: Leave clock-out empty if the person is still at the clinic. A clock-out earlier than the clock-in counts as the next day.
attendance.reason_ph: e.g. Forgot to clock out; left at 17:00
attendance.add_reason_ph: e.g. Phone battery was empty; arrived at 08:55
attendance.delete_confirm: Delete this attendance record of {name}? This cannot be undone.
attendance.add_sub: For a shift that was not clocked. The reason is kept in the audit log.
attendance.hours_lead: Working hours decide who is late or absent. Doctors follow their own schedule from their profile.
attendance.clinic_hours_sub: Used for staff without their own hours.
attendance.clinic_hours_help: Leave both times empty if you do not want late and absent to be tracked.
attendance.plan_since: Late and absent are tracked from {date}. Earlier days are never counted as absences.
attendance.legend_present: Clocked in on time (within the grace minutes).
attendance.legend_late: First clock-in of the day was after the start time plus the grace minutes.
attendance.legend_absent: A working day with no clock-in, after the start time plus the grace minutes.
attendance.legend_not_yet: Today, before the start time plus the grace minutes.
attendance.legend_off: Not a working day for this person (or a doctor’s day off).
attendance.legend_order: Hours come from the person’s own hours if set, otherwise the doctor’s schedule for linked doctors, otherwise the clinic hours.
attendance.staff_hours_sub: Set own hours for anyone who works different days or times (e.g. evening shift).
attendance.use_default_confirm: Remove the own hours of {name}? The clinic hours (or the doctor’s schedule) will apply.
attendance.own_hours_sub: Same start and end time on the chosen days.
attendance.own_hours_help: A clock-out time earlier than the start time means the shift ends after midnight.
attendance.hours_invalid: Enter a valid start and end time.
attendance.screens_lead: A tablet or PC at the clinic door shows a QR code that changes every 10 seconds. Staff scan it with their phone camera to clock in and out.
attendance.screens_empty_text: Add a screen for each entrance, then open it on the device at the door.
attendance.screen_add_sub: A tablet, TV or PC screen at the entrance.
attendance.screen_created: Screen added. Open it on the device at the door.
attendance.screen_regenerated: New link created. Open the screen again on the device.
attendance.screen_regenerate_confirm: Create a new link for this screen? The current link stops working and the screen must be opened again.
attendance.screen_delete_confirm: Delete the screen “{name}”? Its link stops working.
attendance.screen_gone: This screen link is no longer valid. Open the screen again from Attendance → Door screens.
attendance.how_1: Add a screen and open its link on the tablet or PC at the door. Tap the screen once to go full screen and leave it on.
attendance.how_2: The screen shows the clinic logo, the time and a QR code that changes every 10 seconds, so a photo of it stops working quickly.
attendance.how_3: Staff scan the code with their phone camera. If they are not signed in on the phone, they sign in once and the scan still counts.
attendance.how_4: They tap Clock in or Clock out. The screen shows the latest check-ins; managers see the board, late and absent.
attendance.kiosk_security: The screen link does not sign anyone in: the device at the door cannot open patient or clinic data. Keep the link private and create a new one if it leaks.
attendance.qr_only: Clock in/out only by scanning the QR code
attendance.qr_only_help: The Clock in / Clock out button on each person’s own page is replaced by a hint to scan the code at the door.
attendance.same_network: Accept scans only from the clinic network
attendance.same_network_help: The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi / internet connection as a door screen that is on, so a photo of the code sent to someone outside does not work.
attendance.scan_to_clock: Scan to clock in or out
attendance.scan_sub: Open your phone camera and point it at the code.
attendance.kiosk_step_3: Tap Clock in or Clock out
attendance.feed_empty: No one has clocked in yet today.
attendance.confirm_out: You are clocked in since {time}. Tap to record that you are leaving.
attendance.done_in_sub: Have a good day at the clinic.
attendance.done_out_sub: Thank you — see you next shift.
attendance.app_url_title: The site address (APP_URL) is not set
attendance.app_url_text: It is now “{current}”. Links in e-mails, invitations and password resets are built from it, so they point to the wrong address. (The attendance QR code already uses the address the site was opened on.) Set APP_URL = {suggested} in the server environment and restart the app.
attendance.reach_lan_help: This page is open as “localhost”, which phones cannot reach, so the QR code and screen links use this computer’s network address instead. Staff phones must be on the same Wi-Fi as this computer:
attendance.reach_local: Phones cannot open this QR code: the site is running as “localhost” and no network address was found. Open {brand} with its real address (or set APP_URL) and make sure staff phones can reach it.

errors_attendance.QR_INVALID: This QR code is not valid. Scan the code on the screen at the door.
errors_attendance.QR_EXPIRED: This code has changed. Scan the code currently on the screen at the door.
errors_attendance.QR_NETWORK: Connect your phone to the clinic Wi-Fi and scan again.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_QR_ONLY: Your clinic records attendance by scanning the QR code on the screen at the door.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_NOT_MEMBER: Your account is not an active staff member of this clinic.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_OTHER_CLINIC: This code belongs to a clinic your account does not work at.
errors_attendance.ATTENDANCE_OVERLAP: This person already has a shift at that time. Correct that shift instead.
